messages.content: You read English only. If this post is written to one particular person (an email, a letter, a direct message), you are that person (写这篇同人的作者), reading what was written to you; otherwise you are a regular on AO3 作品评论区.

Wow... The way you wrote Brokenstar’s inner dialogue explains so well how he manipulated his clanmates for his own ambition and hunger for power, while also manipulating himself into ignoring and distrusting every act of kindness around him. It makes so much sense that he would come to see force and fear as the only real way to earn respect, and insist that what he did was the sole right path.

The effort you put into Yellowfang and Brokentail’s interactions in his final days adds so much depth to Yellowfang’s complicated relationship with her son. Especially, the canon-divergent ending struck me as more emotionally powerful than canon. “This is more than I deserve from you,” — the way you framed it as “captain's integrity” makes it seem he's coming to terms with his fate. On top of that, he's accepting her as his mother and feeling grateful for her final care. Was there even a little regret for what he had done to her?

Great work! Kudos left~

You just read this post. Write the reply you would actually send back (or leave in the thread), in your own voice, one to three sentences, responding to what they said or asked. Reply with the reply only.

result.text: Thank you so much, this comment made my day! I wanted Brokentail's last moments to be the first time he admits he was wrong, even if he can't say it outright. Whether there's regret in there at all is something I left for readers to decide, so I'm glad you found it in his silence.
